criteria.name: B33-1
criteria.text: Every coefficient of the Thirteenth Schedule is exactly two-thirds of the corresponding coefficient of the Twelfth, over all seven bands and four age columns, slopes and intercepts alike.

criteria.name: B33-2
criteria.text: The Fourteenth Schedule is cell for cell identical to the Twelfth; only the variable it is read against differs (total monthly sum against average monthly income).

criteria.detail: 5 written classes carrying 6 clause vectors, 0 colliding pairs
criteria.name: B33-3
criteria.text: No two of the classes the instrument writes receive an identical clause vector on all five dimensions. A collision would put the read partition strictly coarser than the written one.

criteria.name: B33-4
criteria.text: Every page of the instrument was opened, and the coverage table names what each batch carried, including batches that carried nothing bearing on the criteria.

criteria.detail: 1 of 5 written classes carry more than one vector: 8AB eligible Group A worker
criteria.name: B33-5
criteria.text: Where the read partition is strictly finer than the written one, the extra line is drawn by the instrument itself and can be named. Every class carrying more than one clause vector has its dividing provisions listed; a split with no provision behind it would put the read partition finer than the written one and fail the arm.

8AB eligible Group A worker: reg 13B(1)(b)(ii): the cash proportion moves from one-tenth to two-fifths at applicable year 2029
reg 13C(2)(b): the benefit table moves from the Thirteenth to the Twelfth Schedule at applicable year 2029

group_a_merges_with_employee.dimension_benefit_table: Thirteenth to Twelfth Schedule at applicable year 2029, reg 13C(2)(b)
group_a_merges_with_employee.dimension_cash_proportion: one-tenth to two-fifths at applicable year 2029, reg 13B(1)(b)(ii)
